decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was launched only in 2024, and its prospects are still uncertain, so keeping it open on the website costs little. It extends the firm's core automation line, although the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows the firm prunes or rebrands machine variants readily.
Production analysis software is cheap to maintain and complements the firm's digital lifecycle offering, so the option should stay open until its value becomes clear.
